==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I had another lucid dream triggered by moving my body in the waking world while still asleep.
This time I wanted to climb a mountain. When I reached the top it felt too easy, so I tried again but on a mountain in Hell.

At the peak of Hell Mountain, I met a tan skinned redhead, medieval, demon woman with short hair, fangs, and big green eyes. I recognized her as my subconscious. She pushed me off the mountain, but I saved myself by becoming a superhero.
